record.paper_title: Topological Open Problems in the Geometry of Banach Spaces
record.original_question: If a Banach space X has a Fréchet differentiable norm, must X admit an equivalent locally uniformly rotund norm? A norm is locally uniformly rotund when, for every sequence x_n and point x, the condition 2||x||^2+2||x_n||^2−||x+x_n||^2→0 implies ||x−x_n||→0.

evidence.quote: A norm k · k in a real vector space X is said to be locally uniformly rotund (LUR) if, asymptotically, it has a local behavior similar to the parallelogram law: limn (2kxk2 + 2kxnk2 − kx + xnk2) = 0 ⇒ limnkx − xnk = 0 for any sequence (xn) and x in X.
Question 7. Let X be a Banach space with a Fréchet differentiable norm. Does it follow that X admits an equivalent locally uniformly rotund norm?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let X be a real Banach space. A norm ‖·‖ on X is said to be Fréchet differentiable if at every nonzero point x ∈ X the limit
  lim_{t→0} (‖x+th‖ − ‖x‖)/t
exists uniformly for h in the unit sphere of X. A norm ‖·‖ on X is called locally uniformly rotund (LUR) if for every x ∈ X and every sequence (x_n) in X,
  lim_{n→∞} (2‖x‖² + 2‖x_n‖² − ‖x + x_n‖²) = 0   ⟹   lim_{n→∞} ‖x − x_n‖ = 0.
Two norms on X are called equivalent if they induce the same topology.

Question: Suppose X admits an equivalent Fréchet differentiable norm. Does X necessarily admit an equivalent locally uniformly rotund norm?
artifact.status_search_result: The implication "Fréchet differentiable renorming ⇒ LUR renorming" is a well-known open problem in the geometry of Banach spaces. Partial positive results exist (e.g., when the dual norm is also Gâteaux differentiable, or when X has an unconditional basis), but the general question remains unresolved in the literature available through 2026.

status_evidence.title: Fréchet Differentiable Norm and Locally Uniformly Rotund Renormings
status_evidence.snippet: The core question is: 'Assume X admits an equivalent Fréchet differentiable norm. Does X admit an equivalent LUR norm?' Partial positive results are known under additional hypotheses.
status_evidence.claim: The problem is stated explicitly as open, with partial results under extra assumptions.

status_evidence.title: Some classical and recent results concerning renormings
status_evidence.snippet: Survey on renorming theory in Banach spaces discussing Fréchet smoothness and LUR renormability.
status_evidence.claim: Renorming surveys treat the implication from Fréchet smoothness to LUR as an unresolved direction.
